snippet.title: Big Hops | Wholesome Direct 2025
snippet.description: EXCLUSIVE: Meet #BIGHOPS! Tongue-swing, free climb, and build your own path forward in a new kind of 3D platformer! Plant veggie bounce pads, tightropes, hookshots, and much more. Check out the demo and back on Kickstarter! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chriswade/big-hops #WholesomeDirect #IndieGames #SummerGameFest
